description: This file defines the 'Coupon' controller class for the Opencart admin marketing module. It manages CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, deletion, and history viewing of coupons within the admin interface.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketing coupons in the admin interface, handling listing, creation, editing, deletion, enabling/disabling, and viewing history.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up the coupon list view page, including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and the list data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves coupon data, handles pagination, and renders the coupon list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a coupon, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the save operation for adding or updating a coupon, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history related to a specific coupon.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the history entries and pagination for a specific coupon.
